rules: A planned witness contract is not runtime evidence or candidate approval.
Positive and negative witness IDs are stable; evidence artifacts bind exact Creator version, fixture hash, build commit and artifact SHA-256.
Every count-eligible candidate references all declared prerequisite contracts and owns candidate-specific positive/negative IDs.
Candidate qualification requires all prerequisite witnesses plus its candidate-specific observable contract evidence.
